bank.retain_mission: Extract codebase file structure, module organization, entrypoints, exported symbol mappings, and dependency tree relationships. Ignore temporary scratch files and verbose directory listings.
bank.observations_mission: Track repository structure evolution, module additions, directory layouts, and dependency graph mapping over time.
bank.reflect_mission: Synthesize a concise codebase architecture map detailing directory structure, core module responsibilities, entry points, and symbol export locations.

mental_models.name: Codebase Structure & Layout
mental_models.source_query: What is the overall directory organization, core module layout, entrypoints, and responsibilities of each directory?

mental_models.name: Exported Symbols & Dependency Graphs
mental_models.source_query: Where are key classes, functions, interfaces, and types defined and exported across modules?
